articles.title: GitHub Copilot Global Model Policy Enforces Default States
articles.description: GitHub is rolling out enforcement for Copilot global model policies across enterprise plans, updating unconfigured model states automatically.
articles.summary: GitHub has officially launched the general availability of its global model policy, standardizing how enterprise plans inherit Copilot model access.

articles.title: GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio August 2026 Update Details
articles.description: Learn about the August 2026 update for GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio, including organizational agents, reasoning effort controls, and Git code reviews.
articles.summary: The August 2026 update for GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio introduces enhanced model management, reasoning controls, organization-wide custom agents, and automated Git reviews.

articles.title: Google Releases Chrome 152 for Android
articles.description: Google has announced Chrome 152 for Android, rolling out performance fixes and matching desktop security patches via Google Play.
articles.summary: Google has begun rolling out Chrome 152 for Android, delivering stability updates and matching desktop security fixes to mobile devices.

articles.title: Google Releases Chrome 152 with 327 Security Fixes
articles.description: Chrome 152 brings 327 security patches to Windows, Mac, and Linux, addressing critical use-after-free and memory issues across core browser engines.
articles.summary: Google has promoted Chrome 152 to the stable desktop channel, rolling out hundreds of security patches across supported operating systems.
